Name: Product_Ancestry
Description: The class Product_Ancestry describes aggregation or membership relationships between a PDS4 product and its parent aggregate products.

Name: parent_bundle_identifier
Description: The logical identifier of the parent bundle that contains or aggregates the product.

Name: parent_collection_identifier
Description: The logical identifier of the parent collection that contains or aggregates the product.

Name: registry_membership_complete
Description: Indicates whether all expected members of an aggregate product are present in the registry. True indicates complete membership; false indicates that one or more expected members are missing or not linked.

Name: registry_membership_evaluation_date_time
Description: The date and time at which registry membership completeness was last evaluated.

Name: comment
Description: The comment attribute is a character string expressing one or more remarks or thoughts relevant to the object.

Name: Processing_Provenance
Description: The class Processing_Provenance captures Engineering Node operational provenance generated during harvest and registry activities for a product.

Name: harvest_id
Description: The identifier assigned to the harvest activity associated with the product.

Name: harvest_date_time
Description: The date and time at which the product was harvested.

Name: harvest_version
Description: The version of the harvesting software used to harvest the product.

Name: harvest_source
Description: Identifies the source from which the product was harvested.

Name: harvest_job_identifier
Description: The identifier assigned to the harvest job that processed the product.

Name: harvest_profile_identifier
Description: The identifier of the harvest configuration profile used to process the product.

Name: registry_id
Description: The URI that identifies the product record in the registry.

Name: registry_version
Description: The version of the registry record associated with the product.

Name: registry_sweepers_ancestry_version
Description: The version of the Registry Sweepers ancestry process applied to the product.

Name: registry_sweepers_repairkit_version
Description: The version of the Registry Sweepers repair kit applied to the product.

Name: derived_from_identifier
Description: The identifier of a source product containing input data used in the creation of the described product. The source product may be within or outside the PDS4 Registry. External source products should be documented consistently with the PDS Source_Product_External class.

Name: comment
Description: The comment attribute is a character string expressing one or more remarks or thoughts relevant to the object.

Name: Systems_Lifecycle_Status
Description: The class Systems_Lifecycle_Status captures the current operational state of a product within the Engineering Node operational workflow. The lifecycle phase identifies where the product is in the workflow, while the lifecycle state identifies the state of activity within that phase. When systems_lifecycle_phase = release and systems_lifecycle_state = complete, the product is publicly available online.

Name: systems_lifecycle_phase
Description: (Definition not provided — replace with an authored definition.)

Name: available
Description: The product is made available through an operational release workflow. When systems_lifecycle_state = complete, the product is publicly available online.

Name: ingest
Description: The product is being transferred from a data provider to the PDS for acceptance, harvesting, loading, and registration.

Name: offline
Description: The product has been taken offline and is no longer publicly available through operational systems.

Name: preparation
Description: The product is being planned, generated, documented, packaged, or otherwise prepared by a data provider for submission to PDS for archive or operational handling.

Name: review
Description: The product is undergoing operational, technical, or approval review.

Name: staging
Description: The product has been prepared for release and is staged in an operational system but is not yet publicly available online.

Name: systems_lifecycle_state
Description: (Definition not provided — replace with an authored definition.)

Name: blocked
Description: The lifecycle phase cannot proceed until an issue, dependency, or decision is resolved.

Name: complete
Description: The lifecycle phase has been completed.

Name: failed
Description: The lifecycle phase did not complete successfully.

Name: in_progress
Description: The lifecycle phase is currently underway.

Name: pending
Description: The lifecycle phase has not yet started.

Name: status_date_time
Description: (Definition not provided — replace with an authored definition.)

Name: status_message
Description: (Definition not provided — replace with an authored definition.)

Name: Archive_Lifecycle_Status
Description: The class Archive_Lifecycle_Status captures the state of a product, collection, or bundle within the PDS archival review, preparation, and release lifecycle.

Name: archive_lifecycle_state
Description: (Definition not provided — replace with an authored definition.)

Name: in_internal_review
Description: The product is undergoing an internal evaluation before formal peer review.

Name: in_lien_resolution
Description: Review has identified issues or liens that are being resolved.

Name: in_peer_review
Description: The product is currently undergoing formal review for archival acceptance.

Name: not_reviewed
Description: The product has not yet entered the evaluation process.

Name: rejected
Description: The product did not satisfy requirements for archival acceptance.

Name: released
Description: The product has successfully completed archive evaluation and has been publicly released through the archive.

Name: archive_quality
Description: (Definition not provided — replace with an authored definition.)

Name: external
Description: Product quality is indeterminate and is not intended for formal inclusion in the PDS archive and may be made available externally to the archive.

Name: needs_improvement
Description: The product requires additional work before meeting archive quality requirements.

Name: satisfactory
Description: The product satisfies archive quality requirements.

Name: undetermined
Description: Archive quality has not yet been determined.

Name: accumulating_data_flag
Description: Indicates whether the product is accumulating under the PDS Policy on Accumulating Data. True indicates that data are being delivered incrementally at intervals mutually agreeable to the data provider and the PDS node. False indicates that the product was accumulating but the final increment has now been ingested. When the attribute is absent, the product is not designated as accumulating.

Name: archive_status_date_time
Description: The date and time at which the archive status was assigned or updated.

Name: archive_status_message
Description: Free-text notes describing archive status.

Name: Validation_Assessment

Description: (Definition not provided — replace with an authored definition.)

Name: failed
Description: The product failed the validation assessment.

Name: not_tested
Description: The product has not been validated.

Name: passed
Description: The product passed the validation assessment.

Name: passed_with_warnings
Description: The product passed validation but produced one or more warnings.

Name: unknown
Description: The validation result is not known.

Name: validator_name
Description: The name of the validation tool, service, or application used to perform the validation assessment.

Name: validator_version
Description: The version of the validation tool, service, or application used to perform the validation assessment.

Name: validation_date_time
Description: The date and time at which the validation assessment was performed.

Name: validation_message_text
Description: A human-readable description of a validation result, warning, or error generated during validation.

Name: action_required
Description: Indicates whether the validation assessment identified issues requiring corrective action.

Name: Validated_Against
Description: The class Validated_Against identifies a PDS4 information model namespace and version used during a validation assessment.

Name: namespace_id
Description: The namespace identifier of the information model or local data dictionary used during validation.

Name: pds4_version_id
Description: The PDS4 version identifier associated with the namespace.
